films.title: Troy
films.description: Brad Pitt's Achilles and Eric Bana's Hector duel outside the walls — Hollywood's most watched restaging of Iliad XXII.

popCulture.title: Hector
popCulture.description: Troy's defender chased three times around the walls — Hector remains the Iliad's human face of doomed courage.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.description: Book XXII's duel and the dragging of the corpse still define how epic imagines a city's last champion.
